paper_id: Mao et al. - 2013 - Finding Best and Worst k-Coverage Paths in Multihop Wireless Sensor Networks
title: Finding Best and Worst k-Coverage Paths in Multihop Wireless Sensor Networks
motivation: 无线传感网络部署需保证k覆盖服务质量,经济与应用双重需求驱动
problem_framing: 在传感节点集合中求源宿点间k-support(最小化最大kth距离)和k-breach路径(最大化最小kth距离)
key_insight: 最优k-support路径必由完美支撑点线段组成;最优k-breach路径必沿kth-NP Voronoi边
method_signature: 构建kth-NP Voronoi图,化为加权图最短路问题,复杂度O(k²n log n)
evaluation_criteria: 理论证明最优性,时间复杂度O(k²n log n),通用k非仅常数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Fang等人的binary search算法无法保证最优解,k须为常数减少通用性
evidence_for_taste: Unfortunately, their algorithms cannot guarantee an optimum solution
their algorithm may not return the optimal k-support path
their algorithms cannot guarantee an optimum solution
This is the first work that presents polynomial time algorithms
we try to reduce the time complexity of our algorithm
thinking_moves: 引入kth-NP Voronoi图作为计算几何基础结构
通过定理证明将连续路径搜索空间约束到离散完美支撑点
将路径优化问题等价转换为图中最短路径问题
利用层次分解(order-k Voronoi + farthest Voronoi)构造kth-NP Voronoi
分布式实现中让各节点本地构建子图后合并
cites_own_work: [15] Tang, Mao, Li - Optimal k-support coverage paths in wireless sensor networks (2009)
extraction_notes: 该文为2013年论文含完整intro/method/eval/conclusion;作者刘云浩为署名co-author(含email及单位);文中明确批评前人算法不能保证最优解,是强 taste 信号;论文明确声称首次为一般k(非常数)提供多项式时间最优算法 | md truncated to head40k+tail20k
